messages:
priya: Heads-up — PM pushed a customer ask for high-throughput streaming (large sessions). They want it this quarter. SRE budgeted SLO/toil work instead. How do we prioritize? RICE pls.

alex_chan: Quick gut: reliability-first. If we ship without caching & batching fixes we'll see cost+incidents. Rough RICE compare: Feature R:8 I:6 C:5 E:3 -> 64. SLO/toil R:9 I:8 C:4 E:4 -> 72. (+1 weight for reliability)

jonathan_k: Agree with alex. Toil reduction has compounding wins — reduces mean-time-to-change and future PR friction. Also need cost model for streaming. If cost delta is >30% the PM won't be happy.

maya_s: Small calc and launch criteria suggestion:
```
RICE = (Reach * Impact * Confidence) / Effort
Feature: Reach=8 Impact=6 Confidence=5 Effort=3 => 64
SRE: Reach=9 Impact=8 Confidence=4 Effort=4 => 72
```
Proposed launch criteria for any shipping option: p95 latency <200ms, error rate <0.5%, canary at 5% for 48h, automated rollback path, runbook + alerting updated.

frank_o: Scope negotiation idea: can PM accept a reduced-MVP for the customer (disable large sessions fallback to dedicated-capacity offering) so we can buy time for SLO work? If PM can gate heavy load behind a paid tier, we can ship faster.

oncall-bot: [alert] Recent 503 spikes when prefix cache evicted — evidence we need caching/KV resilience work. See incident 2025-11-12-evict.

alex_chan: Suggestion: prioritize a 2-sprint SLO/toil sprint that delivers: 1) prefix cache resilience, 2) automated prefix warm-up, 3) golden canary tests for streaming paths. Then follow-up sprint for the customer-facing feature behind dedicated capacity. That lets PM demo capability while we harden infra.

deploy-bot: Canary window for cache resilience patch scheduled: 2025-11-20T14:00Z -> 2025-11-22T14:00Z.

priya: Proposal decision: do SLO + toil reduction first (Q2 sprint), accept reduced-scope MVP for customer behind dedicated tier. Owners: alex_chan -> infra changes; maya_s -> canary/tests + runbooks; jonathan_k -> cost model & docs. I'll take action to negotiate scope with PM.

frank_o: +1. Add explicit rollback checklist and SLA communication to customers.

maya_s: I'll create a checklist and a tiny test harness this afternoon.

priya: Thanks — sounds good. We'll update roadmap doc and send to PM. :white_check_mark:
